english.title: Driver make wrong correction in drivers record book

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: DRIVERS HOURS GOODS VEHICLES KEEPING OF RECORDS REGULATIONS 1987

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), corrected an entry in a drivers' record book other than by striking through the original entry in such a way that it could still be read and by writing the appropriate correction near to the entry struck through
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 8(8) of the Drivers' Hours (Goods Vehicles) (Keeping of Records) Regulations 1987 and section 98(4) of the Transport Act 1968.
